bucket_rules.high_confidence_signal: Any semantic signature, suspicious path marker, dangerous encoded token, or double-encoded token is non-zero.
bucket_rules.review_structural_or_encoding_only: No high-confidence signal, but delimiter/entropy/ordinary URL-encoding signal is present.
bucket_rules.unresolved: No high-confidence, structural, entropy, or encoding signal is present.

interpretation: High-confidence signals are eligible for model training review. Structural/encoding-only rows remain review candidates because ordinary URL encoding overlaps benign traffic. Unresolved rows must not be auto-relabelled or used for promotion without manual evidence.
